answers:
All three generated configs now show 262144 and no 131072 remains. Other settings verified unchanged (deep-thinker 200000/32768, tiny-chat 32768/4096, all output/tool_calling values match the pre-change files above).

[goal] Make OpenCode, Codex and Claude Code agree on fast-coder's context window (262144) permanently.

[action] The three configs in `out/` are generated by `gen.py` from `models.json`, the source of truth. `models.json` said 131072; `out/opencode.json` had drifted to 262144 because it was hand-edited instead of regenerated. So I fixed the source, not the copies:
- `models.json`: `fast-coder` `context_window` 131072 → 262144 (only change).
- Ran `python gen.py` to regenerate all three files in `out/`.

Assumption: hand-patching `out/` would not be "for good", since the install step copies `out/` and any future `gen.py` run would revert it; editing `models.json` is the durable fix.

[result] `Select-String -Path out\* -Pattern "262144|131072"` after regeneration shows exactly:
- `out\opencode.json:9: "context": 262144`
- `out\codex.toml:2: context_window = 262144`
- `out\claude.json:5: "contextWindow": 262144`

with zero 131072 matches. Full file contents read before and after confirm every other model and setting is byte-identical apart from the fast-coder context line.

[next] Nothing pending; no browser or apps were opened. If these configs are deployed, re-run the install step so the workstations pick up the regenerated files.
